services.name: Shadowfax - The Catamaran
services.desc: Shadowfax is a multi-hulled, rotating, wing-masted cruising catamaran sailboat. She was made for cruising safely along the Pacific Coast in an eco-friendly way. She has a shallow draft, is stable, comfortable and fast. Adult life jackets are on hand but do not need to be worn; although all children should wear life jackets. These are provided. Bare feet, boat shoes or other non-marking must be worn. Bring along layered clothing...it may get hotter or cooler on the water. You are welcome to bring your own food or your own refreshments. blurb: Island Marine Adventures offers safe learning experiences on the water tailored to individuals, couples, families, students, groups, or employees. Trips focus on appreciating, exploring, and enjoying the culture, wildlife, biodiversity, and natural beauty of the Nanaimo marine and Island region. They offer 2 hour Sunset Cruises starting around 7 p.m., which may be mixed groups.
extraNote: No trips in rainy or bad weather or unsafe conditions · Call 2-3 days prior to booking to confirm weather and trip status
